record.name: Trinidad and Tobago
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. UNESCO's readiness assessment, led by its lead expert for the country, was the subject of a validation workshop held with the Ministry of Public Administration and Artificial Intelligence in February 2026; our searches identified no named AI regulator or institute.

searches.query: Trinidad and Tobago national AI safety institute advanced model evaluation government

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: UWI's firsthand host account describes the ministry/UNESCO national AI-readiness assessment and the February 2026 validation of findings from January consultations, with named ministry participation and a national governance roadmap. This establishes an organised government assessment process; the roadmap and recommended bodies are not treated as adopted institutions.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Public Administration and Artificial Intelligence (MPAAI)
related_bodies.role: It leads national AI policy work and the UNESCO readiness assessment; no model evaluation mandate was found.

related_bodies.name: AI Innovation Centre (UWI St Augustine)
related_bodies.role: It is a university research and governance centre; it is not a government-designated evaluation body.

record.notes: Both sources are secondary. The ministry coordinates the UNESCO RAM and UNDP landscape assessment (launched 26 November 2025). The UNDP page on the national AI framework returned HTTP 403. The AI Innovation Centre at the University of the West Indies (launched 2025) is a university centre for research, capacity-building and policy, not a government evaluation body.
